title: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property
text: Whoever cheats and thereby dishonestly induces the person deceived to deliver any property to any person shall be punished with imprisonment or fine or both.

title: Criminal breach of trust
text: Whoever commits criminal breach of trust shall be punished with imprisonment or fine or both.

title: Cheating
text: Whoever, by deceiving any person, fraudulently or dishonestly induces the person to deliver property is said to cheat.

title: Punishment for cheating
text: Whoever cheats shall be punished with imprisonment or fine or both.

title: Forgery
text: Whoever makes any false document with intent to cause damage or injury is said to commit forgery.

title: Forgery for purpose of cheating
text: Whoever commits forgery intending that the document forged shall be used for cheating shall be punished.

title: Using forged document as genuine
text: Whoever fraudulently uses as genuine any forged document shall be punished.

title: Acts done by several persons in furtherance of common intention
text: When a criminal act is done by several persons in furtherance of the common intention, each is liable.

title: Criminal conspiracy
text: Whoever is a party to a criminal conspiracy shall be punished.

title: Abetment
text: A person abets the doing of a thing who instigates or aids in doing that thing.

title: What agreements are contracts
text: All agreements are contracts if made by free consent of parties competent to contract for a lawful consideration and lawful object.

title: Fraud
text: Fraud includes acts committed with intent to deceive another party or induce them to enter into a contract.

title: Misrepresentation
text: Misrepresentation means a positive assertion not warranted by the information of the person making it.

title: What considerations and objects are lawful
text: The consideration or object of an agreement is lawful unless forbidden by law or opposed to public policy.

title: Effect of refusal to perform promise
text: When a party refuses to perform, the promisee may put an end to the contract.

title: Compensation for loss or damage caused by breach of contract
text: When a contract has been broken, the party suffering is entitled to compensation for any loss.

title: Compensation for breach where penalty stipulated
text: Compensation not exceeding the penalty stipulated may be awarded.

title: Definition of evidence
text: Evidence means and includes all statements and documents permitted by the court.

title: Confession caused by inducement
text: A confession caused by inducement, threat or promise is irrelevant in criminal proceedings.

title: Opinions of experts
text: When the court has to form an opinion on science or art, opinions of experts are relevant.

title: Electronic records admissibility
text: Electronic records shall be admissible if conditions under Section 65B are satisfied.

title: Courts to try all civil suits
text: Courts shall have jurisdiction to try all suits of a civil nature.

title: Inherent powers of court
text: Nothing shall limit the inherent power of the court to make orders for justice.

title: When police may arrest without warrant
text: Police may arrest a person without warrant in cognizable offences.

title: Power to examine the accused
text: Court may examine the accused after prosecution evidence is complete.
